initiative.title: OpenAgents Desktop: your coding agents in one Mac window, in Coax
initiative.body: Owner's order: first the same Claude Agent SDK chat as openagents.com/chat, working locally on the user's own Claude Code login (milestone desk-local-chat). Then Codex beside it, sessions, and the room where the agents talk to each other.

milestones.title: Zeron's UI in Coax, pixel for pixel
milestones.body: Owner's direction (2026-10-29): the desktop app, and later the web app, moves off the HUD look to UI forked from Zeron (Rust/GPUI, MIT, by Wing). Coax components drawn on the GPU the way GPUI draws them (quads with radii, borders and shadows, glyph-atlas text), one component at a time, each matched pixel for pixel against a screenshot of Zeron.

milestones.title: First: the web chat, running on your own Claude
milestones.body: The owner's first goal. The same Claude Agent SDK chat as openagents.com/chat (conversations, model chips Haiku, Sonnet and Opus 5.5 defaulting to Opus, STOP, cost per turn), but in a Mac window, running the user's installed `claude` with the user's own Claude Code login. No API key, no OpenAgents account, nothing sent to our servers.

milestones.title: Codex beside Claude, one transcript
milestones.body: Codex through `codex app-server`, and both harnesses normalized into one event model so one transcript draws either.

milestones.title: Sessions: sidebar, tabs, approvals
milestones.body: Several sessions at once, Claude Code or Codex each, in folders, with the old app's layout cut to the basics.

milestones.title: Agents that talk to each other
milestones.body: A shared room: ask_agent, tell_agent, agents_list and room_read as MCP tools for both harnesses, every message visible, no courtesy loops, STOP cancels waiting asks.

milestones.title: Resume, settings and a signed app
milestones.body: Sessions survive a restart, settings persist, missing or logged-out CLIs get one-line help, and a notarized .app/.dmg is built from this Mac.

tasks.title: A new chat screen with Zeron's input bar, pixel for pixel
tasks.body:
A brand new chat screen in apps/openagents-desktop/, connected to nothing, whose composer is an exact match of Zeron's GPUI input bar (/Users/christopherdavid/work/zeron, its UI crate and default theme). GPUI-style primitives in Coax (rounded quad with border and shadow, glyph-atlas text in Zeron's font) drawn by the Metal host. Typing, backspace, caret and placeholder work; send does nothing. The app opens on this screen; the HUD chat, LAB and router stay in the tree but aren't shown.

Reference: a screenshot of a Zeron dev build at a known size and scale. The pre-nuke Zeron adaptation is at 0b401561a0^:apps/openagents/. Attribution: Based on Zeron by Wing, MIT.
acceptance: build.sh makes OpenAgents.app from a clean checkout and it opens on the new screen
A --shot of the empty chat at the reference size matches the Zeron screenshot in the composer region, with the measured difference reported
Typing into the composer shows the text and caret; backspace works; the placeholder shows when empty
coax test passes for every new .coax file

tasks.title: The composer edits text the way Zeron's does
tasks.body: Full text editing in the Zeron composer, at parity with Zeron's composer (crates/ui/src/composer.rs and the GPUI it uses): selection with Shift/Alt/Cmd arrows, click, drag, double-click word, triple-click all; word and line movement and deletion; typing or pasting over a selection replaces it; Cmd+A/C/X/V through NSPasteboard; Cmd+Z / Cmd+Shift+Z undo and redo with Zeron's coalescing; a standard menu bar (app menu with Quit; Edit with Undo, Redo, Cut, Copy, Paste, Select All); NSTextInputClient for IME marked text, accents and the emoji picker; multi-line paste. The selection highlight matches a Zeron render in colour and shape.
acceptance: coax test covers selection, undo/redo, replace-on-type and word boundaries, and passes
A --shot with keys or a drag shows a selection drawn like a Zeron render of the same text, with the measured difference reported
Copy and paste go through the real pasteboard in a scripted check
The Edit menu shows Undo, Redo, Cut, Copy, Paste and Select All, and each works
IME marked text works through NSTextInputClient

tasks.title: Mac host: a window that draws Coax HUD output with Metal
tasks.body:
apps/openagents-desktop/: a thin AppKit app (1320x880, min 900x600, inset title bar). It calls a Coax app compiled to C each frame and draws its vertex buffer with a Metal port of the HUD shader (apps/openagents-web/ui.wgsl), using the iOS app's Metal host as the reference. Mouse, keys, text input, scroll and the clipboard reach the app the way host.js delivers them on the web.

Spec: docs/desktop/coax-desktop.md. The old GPUI app this follows is at 0b401561a0^:apps/openagents/ (feature inventory: docs/research/feature-inventory.md there). Product logic is Coax; the Swift host only does window, Metal, input and OS dialogs. Everything visible is drawn by Coax with the HUD components; no comments ship.
acceptance: A build script makes the .app from a clean checkout on this Mac
The window shows a HUD frame and text drawn by Coax at 60 fps on a Retina display
A headless capture of the window matches a committed golden
Typing into a Coax text field and pasting work

tasks.title: Engine: run the local claude CLI with the user's login
tasks.body:
A Coax engine thread that runs `claude` through coax/lib/agent/claude (stream-json, control protocol) and coax/platform/process-native.c. The child gets the user's own environment and login (no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY injected, no OpenAgents credential); the PATH comes from the user's login shell so a Homebrew or ~/.local install is found. The UI talks to the engine only by messages.

tasks.title: The room in the engine
tasks.body:
An ordered log of agent-to-agent messages per window; ask_agent runs a turn in the other session and returns its final answer as the tool result; tell_agent queues for the next turn; an agent waiting on an ask can't be asked by the one it waits on; STOP cancels its asks. No hop limit by default; a user-set one is allowed.

acceptance: Coax tests: ask returns the answer, a reverse ask while waiting is refused, STOP cancels
